item.title: Suffering Is Not Wasted: God’s Purpose in Trials
item.description: Suffering is something every believer will face, yet Scripture teaches that it is never wasted in the hands of a sovereign and good God. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how God uses trials to strengthen faith, refine character, and anchor believers in a hope that does not disappoint.

item.title: Loving Leadership in the Home, Men of Resolve
item.description: In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins continues the Men of Resolve series by addressing loving leadership in the home, rooted in Ephesians 5:25–29 and Joshua 24:15. Biblical leadership is sacrificial, Christlike, and Scripture-shaped—not harshness, passivity, or self-centered control.

item.title: Handling Disagreement Biblically in the Local Church
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains how Christians should handle disagreement within the local church by pursuing humility, careful listening, speaking the truth in love, and unity grounded in God’s Word.
